name: Massey University
summary: Campuses in Palmerston North, Auckland and Wellington; veterinary science and pilot degrees at Manawatu; a preferential entry score of 26 IB points.

handoff.label: Qualifications and courses for international students

ib.text: A complete IB Diploma of 24 points is the entry requirement. If places are limited, your IB total is your rank score and the preferential entry score for most undergraduate degrees is 26.

apply.via: Massey online application for international students

dates.label: New international students: Semester One 2027 (February start)
New international students: Semester Two 2027 (July start)

programmes.name: Bachelor of Veterinary Science (pre-selection semester)
programmes.about: Five years in total on the Manawatu campus. A six-month open-entry pre-selection semester from February decides, with selection assessments, who enters the 4.5-year professional phase that starts in July.
programmes.ib: IB biology, chemistry, physics and maths are the recommended background; selection also needs a 5.0 (B) average and the STAT, Casper and MMI tests.
programmes.selectionNote: About two international applicants compete for each professional-phase place; selection uses pre-selection grades plus STAT, Casper and a multiple mini-interview.

flagshipSource.title: Massey: the veterinary school for the whole of New Zealand, with international students welcome

programmes.name: Bachelor of Aviation
programmes.about: A three-year degree for professional pilots that builds a Commercial Pilot Licence with multi-engine and instrument rating into university study at an internationally recognised training facility.
programmes.ib: A pass in an English-rich IB subject (English, history, geography, biology, economics...); Maths and Physics highly recommended; Class One medical.
programmes.selectionNote: Online ADAPT test, then a selection board with a panel interview, flight simulator and psychometric tests, and writing and maths tasks.

flagshipSource.title: Massey Bachelor of Aviation: a university degree built on professional pilot training

notes: EU citizens pay the international fee: Massey estimates NZ$35,250 to NZ$43,570 for a year of a Bachelor of Arts or Science in 2027 (120 credits, GST included).
Applications after the due date are still considered if spaces remain, but selected-entry degrees such as Aviation close earlier.
On a student visa Immigration New Zealand requires you to hold NZ$20,000 a year for living costs on top of your course fees.
